title: A Letters for the Promise
author: Ansel Ashgrove
blurb: Ada Pemberton, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
